extracted_details.description_text: This enrichment uses the exact version 120.8.4.0 and release date declared in the supplied INF, which was semantically analyzed in full. No official release notes for version 120.8.4.0, nor a verified previous, latest, or family-version release-note fallback, were found. The supplied Intel links identify Intel Management Engine/chipset resources, not this Surface Integration Driver package, so they do not substantiate version-specific changes. The INF identifies ACPI\MSHW0530, a demand-start kernel driver, three power-policy provisioning packages, platform KIP support, display energy-estimation settings, battery-estimator visibility, long-press power-button screen refresh, and BitLocker request limits. These are package behaviors declared in the INF, not claims that version 120.8.4.0 introduced new fixes.
key_components: SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys, installed as a demand-start kernel service for ACPI\MSHW0530.
Three provisioning packages: default, Windows 10-specific, and Windows 11-specific Surface power-policy packages.
SurfaceService PlatformKipSupported registry value, set to 1; the INF comment associates this with KIP power-saving features.
14-point BacklightPowerCurve under Windows EnergyEstimation, mapping brightness percentages from 0% to 100% to backlight-power values.
Windows power registry values for UserBatteryDischargeEstimator and EnableScreenRefreshOnPowerButtonLongPress.
BitLocker fvevol settings for maximum encryption, decryption, and per-I/O crypto requests, each set to 0x40.
key_functionalities: Installs and registers the Surface Integration kernel driver for the INF-declared ACPI\MSHW0530 hardware ID.
Associates default and OS-specific Windows 10/Windows 11 power-policy provisioning packages with the device.
Enables the PlatformKipSupported flag; the INF comment states that this enables KIP power-saving features.
Provides a 14-point brightness-to-backlight-power curve for Windows display energy estimation.
Sets UserBatteryDischargeEstimator to 0xFFFFFFFF, hiding the estimated remaining battery discharge time.
Sets BitLocker encrypt, decrypt, and per-I/O crypto request limits to 0x40; the INF comment specifically says the encryption-request limit is intended to improve SSD performance under BitLocker.
extracted_details.major_components_functionalities_descrip: This enrichment is based on the exact version 120.8.4.0 in the supplied INF, not on previous, latest, or family-version release notes. Semantic analysis of INFDescriptionData shows a demand-start Surface kernel driver for ACPI\MSHW0530 and three default/OS-specific power-policy packages. The INF enables PlatformKipSupported and supplies a 14-point brightness-to-backlight-power curve for Windows energy estimation. It also configures battery discharge-time presentation and screen refresh on a long power-button press. Its fvevol values set BitLocker encryption and cryptographic request limits; these INF-defined settings are not presented as new version-specific fixes.
impact_details: May affect platform KIP power-saving behavior because the INF explicitly enables PlatformKipSupported.
May affect Windows display energy estimates through the brightness-to-backlight-power curve.
Changes the configured visibility of estimated remaining battery discharge time by setting UserBatteryDischargeEstimator to 0xFFFFFFFF.
Enables the Windows setting for screen refresh following a long power-button long press.
May affect SSD performance during BitLocker activity; the INF comment gives this intent specifically for the encryption-request limit.
May affect Windows 10/Windows 11 power-policy configuration through the three included provisioning packages.
